assessmentQuestionVersion.name: RecWater_RiskAssessment_Q1
assessmentQuestionVersion.responseValues: Large: Pools defined as a public pool under the Pool Regulation, and facilities containing three or more permitted bodies of water. Medium: Commercial pool facilities containing two permitted bodies of water (e.g., a pool and hot tub), as well as recirculating spray pools and recirculating wading pools. Small: Facilities containing a single permitted body of water that is not classified as a public pool under the Pool Regulation, and non-recirculating spray pools or wading pools.
